chapters.t: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
The earth was empty and dark. God's Spirit was moving over the water.
God said, 'Let there be light!' And there was light.
God saw that the light was good. He separated the light from the darkness.
God called the light 'day' and the darkness 'night'. This was the first day.
God made the sky and said it was good.
God made the water and said it was good.
God made the land and the plants. He said it was all good.
God was very happy with what He made.
God made the sun, moon, and stars. He said they were beautiful.
God made the sun to give light during the day.
God made the moon and stars to shine at night.
God made all the animals. He made birds to fly in the sky.
He made fish to swim in the water.
He made animals to walk on the land.
God said all the animals were good.
Then God made a man. He made him in God's own image.
God made him to take care of all the animals and plants.
God made a woman to be his helper.
God said it was all very, very good!
On the seventh day, God rested. He was done making everything.
God blessed the seventh day because it was a day of rest.
God put the man and woman in a beautiful garden called Eden.
The garden had many plants and animals.
God told the man, 'You can eat from any tree here, but there is one tree you must not eat from.'
The man named all the animals.
God made a woman to be his friend and helper.
One day a snake tricked the woman. The snake said, 'Did God really say you cannot eat from that tree?'
The woman forgot what God said. She ate the fruit from the tree.
She gave the fruit to the man, and he ate it too.
Then they both felt sad and afraid. They hid from God.
God was sad because they did not obey Him.
God had to send them out of the beautiful garden.
But God still loved them very much.
God said He would send someone to help all people one day.
